items.summary: Hims & Hers Health (NYSE:HIMS) announced a new partnership with Eli Lilly to offer Zepbound and Foundayo on its platform. The agreement brings fully FDA-approved GLP-1 obesity drugs into the Hims & Hers telehealth ecosystem for eligible patients. Patients will be able to complete consultations, receive prescriptions, and access these Eli Lilly treatments through Hims & Hers digital services.
